allies.rationale_text: Prioritization helps trade-offs turn constrained choice into explicit ranking instead of rhetorical balance.
allies.affinity_rationale: Trade-off decisions require systematic ranking and resource allocation among competing alternatives
allies.activation_condition: When focusing resources requires systematic ranking of competing alternatives

allies.rationale_text: Opportunity-cost sharpens trade-offs by making the hidden cost of saying yes visible.
allies.source_quote: Best when decision quality depends on naming the hidden cost of saying yes
allies.affinity_rationale: Every trade-off implies a foregone alternative; opportunity cost is the intrinsic mechanism of trade-offs
allies.activation_condition: When every choice implies a foregone alternative that must be explicitly valued

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps trade-offs reveal the interrelationships and feedback loops that make one compromise carry costs elsewhere.
allies.source_quote: This framework enables the visualization of interrelationships and feedback loops, revealing the causal links that necessitate trade-offs.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical describes systems thinking as enabling visualization of feedback loops that reveal causal links necessitating trade-offs
allies.activation_condition: When visualizing feedback loops reveals the causal links that necessitate trade-offs

antagonists.rationale_text: Anchoring undermines trade-offs by over-weighting the first frame or metric and obscuring better reallocations.
antagonists.source_quote: This cognitive bias causes over-focus on a single piece of information, preventing objective analysis of trade-offs.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical states anchoring causes over-focus on a single piece of information, preventing objective trade-off analysis
antagonists.activation_condition: When over-focus on a single data point prevents objective analysis of alternatives

structured_tensions.tension_text: Trade-offs conflicts with status-quo-bias when hidden opportunity costs are ignored to preserve defaults.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Trade-offs conflicts with commitment-bias when legacy priorities block reallocation after new evidence.
